entrypoints.chain: PluginManager.start creates _PluginBase -> PluginDataOper/SystemConfigOper/MessageHelper/EventManager/PluginChian; code, state and running instance remain separate.

installed IDs -> _load_selective_plugins -> valid class sorting/auth gate -> class() then init_plugin(saved_config) -> runtime instance map; isolate per-plugin load errors and toggle events by get_state.
HTTP config -> PluginManager.save_plugin_config -> existing instance init_plugin -> register_plugin services/commands/API; persisted config and running refresh are distinct.
reload -> stop/close/stop_service/cache clearing -> start -> PluginReload; dispatch after reload resolves current instance.

Plugin method -> _PluginBase.get_data -> PluginDataOper.get_data; key reads value, omitted key reads database rows. get_data_path lazily creates per-plugin local directory; sync/async operations have separate source paths.
market setting UI save -> system set_setting -> settings/systemconfig selected key persistence -> ConfigChanged; saving repositories does not install all entries.
HTTP sync -> allowed wiki URL -> extract/normalize/merge repository URLs -> persist effective settings -> ConfigChanged; fetch/parse failures return failure without inventing installed plugins.
HTTP list -> local/online selection -> PluginManager.async_get_online_plugins -> market package candidates -> _process_plugin_info -> frontend cards; installed-only branch avoids full market.
repository order/package versions -> version comparison and compatibility -> merge duplicate ID; higher version wins, equal-version source priority retained.
market refresh force -> cached/plugin repository loaders -> fresh candidate list; this does not perform plugin install/update.
HTTP installation -> source/version selection -> PluginHelper install flow -> code/dependencies -> installed IDs -> PluginManager init + register; failures/rollback differ with force.

release list HTTP -> PluginHelper.async_get_plugin_release_versions -> repo release cache/coalescing -> returned versions; explicit historical install must not fallback to latest file tree. History UI separately fetches plugin/history.

package system_version -> PEP version/specifier compatibility -> install dependency protection/health branches. Go migration requires explicit native artifact/runtime adaptation, not Python ZIP metadata-only success.
update uses install with existing plugin ID -> replace code at same identity -> reload saved configuration -> re-register; current release and force rollback branches retained.
clone source tree -> Python class/metadata and federation name/assets rewriting -> copy disabled config without data -> installed IDs/init -> folder membership; limited cleanup on errors.
HTTP reset -> synchronous PluginDataReset compensation -> stop -> forced config/data deletion -> reload + register; order must preserve compensation before deletion.
HTTP uninstall -> remove jobs/API/runtime/installed/folder links; ordinary plugin keeps code/config/data, clone additionally deletes clone files/config/data.

configured local repo paths -> package metadata/compatibility/version candidates -> local install copy; exclude caches/node_modules, reject source=runtime directory; DEV sync exceptions are not general install exceptions.
watch runtime/local repo changes -> installed-only sync -> Python reload or declared Vue dist copy -> coalescing window; requirements change warns rather than reinitializes.

routers/workers/modules -> restore plugins -> load plugins -> scheduler/monitor/command; safe mode skips plugin subsystems; init_extra syncs missing code/deps then refreshes services/commands; isolated shutdown stages.

11 · 2.6 安装：先把代码放好，再登记和创建运行实例
12 · 2.7 Release 与历史：更新日志、可下载资产和指定版本是三件事
13 · 2.8 兼容性与依赖：判断能否安装，以及让代码具备运行条件
14 · 2.9 更新：原 ID 原目录替换，再让同一个配置驱动新代码
15 · 2.10 分身 怎样让同一份插件变成两份独立实例
16 · 2.11 重置 怎样清除设置和运行记录但保留插件
17 · 2.12 卸载 怎样让插件退出系统以及为什么还有残留文件
18 · 2.13 本地仓库：开发目录也是一种明确的安装来源
19 · 2.14 源码热重载：文件事件触发复制与重新导入
20 · 2.15 启动修复：先尽量启动现有插件，再后台补齐和更新
21 · 2.16 备份与复原：安装失败保护和 Docker 持久备份用途不同
22 · 2.17 官方授权等级：决定某插件是否可见、是否被创建实例
23 · 2.18 安装统计：安装事件上报，列表查询汇总后展示
24 · 2.19 插件评分：后端有接口，当前前端没有已接通的评分控件
25 · 3.1 卡片列表：页面显示的插件来自哪里
26 · 3.2 搜索、筛选与排序：多数操作发生在浏览器内
27 · 3.3 文件夹：保存的是分组字典，不是磁盘目录
28 · 3.4 打开设置：默认 model 与已保存 config 怎样合成
29 · 3.5 JSON 表单递归渲染，以及点击保存后真正发生的事
30 · 3.6 详情页：数据先变成组件树，按钮再调用插件接口
31 · 3.7 Vue federation：宿主从插件目录装入已构建的前端模块
32 · 3.8 首页仪表板：发现可选组件与选择展示是两次独立动作
33 · 3.9 侧栏导航和 App 快捷访问：两个不同的数据来源
34 · 3.10 插件日志：读文件、SSE 推送、浏览器过滤和下载各做什么
35 · 3.11 自定义 API 怎样把浏览器请求送到插件方法
36 · 4.1 广播事件：某件事已经发生，请感兴趣的插件各自处理
37 · 4.2 同步 Chain 事件：业务先问一圈，再使用被修改的输入
38 · 4.3 插件定时服务：把一个真实函数交给系统时钟
39 · 4.4 手动运行服务：立即走同一个运行入口，不另造一套任务
40 · 4.5 插件命令：把“/daily”转换成插件自己的业务事件
41 · 4.6 插件输入交互：把用户的下一条回复交回提问的插件
42 · 4.7 通知：构造消息之后，还要经过路由、时段和渠道发送
43 · 4.8 模块覆盖：宿主准备做某件事时，优先询问插件的实现
44 · 4.9 工作流动作：工作流节点直接调用一个插件函数
45 · 4.10 Agent 自定义工具：插件把可实例化的工具类交给 AI
46 · 4.11 内建 AI 插件管理工具：AI 操作插件平台，不是插件贡献的能力
47 · 4.12 认证 provider：插件验证外部身份，核心兑换系统登录
